---
name: "nf-core/bam_docounts_contamination_angsd"
description: "Calculate contamination of the X-chromosome with ANGSD"
keywords:
- "angsd"
- "bam"
- "contamination"
- "docounts"
components:
- "angsd/docounts"
- "angsd/contamination"
input:
- ch_bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM/CRAM file and its index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam),\
      \ path(bai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
- ch_hapmap_file:
    type: "file"
    description: "Hapmap file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(hapmap_file) ]\n"
output:
- txt:
    type: "file"
    description: "Contamination estimation file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
authors:
- "@scarlhoff"
maintainers:
- "@scarlhoff"
version: "0.0.0-20c6e64"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/angsd/docounts@0.0.0-20c6e64"
  - "nf-core/angsd/contamination@0.0.0-20c6e64"
